title: Career Guidance Cell-MGIT Hosts Study Abroad Seminar for CSE and IT Students - MGIT

## Career Guidance Cell-MGIT Hosts Study Abroad Seminar for CSE and IT Students

News Date : 28 Feb 2023News ReportThe Career Guidance Cell-MGIT organized an on campus seminar on “Study Abroad” at A Block Auditorium on 28/2/2023. Mr K.P.Singh,the CEO of IMFS, a reputed overseas education consultancy, Hyderabad, in his seminal talk presented insights into various aspects regarding MS programs in US, UK, Ireland, Australia such as admission process, training for qualifying exams GRE/IELTS/TOEFL, Educational loans, Visa process etc. Nearly 70 III Year II Semester CSE and IT students actively took part in the seminar. Mr. Ajay, IMFS, Dr.C.S.Srinivas, Chairman CGC, Dr. G.Srinivas Reddy, Convenor CGC, Faculty Coordinators CSE and IT co-ordinated the event.
